description: Lightweight, community-governed Git service with repositories, issues, pull requests, packages, and Actions. Runs as a single SQLite-backed container.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install:
The web UI is on port `3002`; Git SSH is on port `2222`. Complete the first-run onboarding at the web UI.

If you access CasaOS from another device, change `FORGEJO__server__ROOT_URL` in the app settings to `http://<casaos-ip>:3002/`.

title: Forgejo
